HomePlace.SourceString: 异象管理局禁制机动队六队

AbilityName.LocalizedString: "In the beginning, none could tell heaven from earth."

Introduction.SourceString: E.T.D六队现任队员，你最正直可靠的朋友之一。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Current member of ETD-6. Your most righteous and reliable friend.

Content.SourceString:
E.T.D六队的核心战斗力，使命必达的执行者，剑指所有涉异犯罪者的利刃。
「这样写真的可以吗？会不会太过了？」
「总比你自己写的『E.T.D六队的一个挺不错的队员』好多了吧。」

旁人对卡厄斯的第一印象，大多是「戴面罩的怪人」，认为他不好亲近；但只要和他稍有接触就会发现，他其实是一个阳光开朗、很好相处的家伙。只要开启了和他的第一句对话，那么随后的交谈便会如同潮水般不断涌来，直到他意识到自己说了太多，或是倾听者表达出不耐烦，或是直到新的任务铃声钻进他的耳朵，他才会停下。
然而入战时，他又会暴露出热血战斗狂的另一面。他有着极强的毅力和仿佛无尽的体力，对认准的目标穷追不舍、死咬不放。有时会因为太过急于抓到犯人，而自动忽略掉目标以外的小事，比如……管理局的规章制度之类的？如果你问起，卡厄斯会大大方方地承认，他从未搞明白过管理局的规则和组织构架，有时甚至会忘了自己现在是管理局一员的事实——好在E.T.D本就是局内受制约最少的队伍。
六队的队友并不怎么在意他的直来直往。或许是因为万能的队长总能解决好后续的麻烦，卡厄斯有时无视手续的做法，反而显著提高了任务的处理效率。负责善后的队长本人并未对此事做出评价。

卡厄斯的异能，是召唤出一团可被塑造成实体的烟雾。烟雾的量并不固定，时多时少，但不会低于一定量。基于过往经验，卡厄斯认为烟雾的多少取决于周围人所犯下的「罪业」，因为他在罪业深重的地方总能够获取更多的烟雾。但这也只是他的推测，实际因素无从得知。
「我的异能这样写对吗？」
「喂喂，你的异能是什么样，我怎么知道对不对？」
Content.LocalizedString:
The core strikeforce of ETD-6, the one who gets things done, the blade that swings at every anomaly crime.
"Can I really say that? Isn't that exaggerating a bit?"
"It's cooler than 'Your friendly ETD-6 member' for sure."

Most people's first impression of Chaos is "that weirdo with the mask." At first, they find Chaos unapproachable, but as long as they spend some time with him, they'd realize that he's joyful, cheerful, and easy-going. The moment you start talking to him, the conversation flows like a tide, until he catches himself talking too much, or the listener becomes impatient, or a new mission notification rings.
In combat, however, he transforms into a battle junkie. His willpower is as strong as iron; he never runs out of stamina, and he refuses to let go of his targets. Sometimes, he's so eager to catch a criminal, that he ignores everything else, such as the Bureau's rules and regulations. If you ask him about the rules, he'll likely admit that he's never figured out the Bureau's red tape or hierarchies. In fact, sometimes, he even forgets he works for the Bureau. Fortunately, he works for one of the most flexible units in the organization.
His teammates in Unit 6 don't mind his quirks. It helps that their all-capable captain can always handle the fallout, so Chaos's habit of ignoring processes has arguably improved the team's performance. The captain, who handles cleanups personally, has made no comment on the matter.

Chaos's Esper ability is summoning a mass of smoke that can be shaped into solid forms. The amount of smoke isn't fixed, but it never drops below a certain level. Chaos believes the output of his smoke corresponds to the past crimes of those around him, as he'd always generated more smoke in places with a criminal history. Still, that's only his theory. The actual mechanism remains unknown.
"Is that how my powers work?"
"Hey, why would you think I know your powers better than you?"

Content.SourceString:
在戴上异象管理局的工牌之前，卡厄斯是格赫罗斯岛的守墓人。那时候他只负责看管罪犯，尚不知道自己未来会做上抓捕罪犯的工作。

他加入异象管理局的契机，源于格赫罗斯岛的一次重大事故：一名危险的异能者罪犯越狱成功。即使事实上并非他的过错，卡厄斯仍然将这一事故归咎到自己的监管不力上，并誓必将其追回——届时，他会带回外界所有应被格赫罗斯岛监押的罪犯，作为赔罪。他发誓在成倍地将功补过之前，不会回去见典狱长。
因为没人能拉住下定决心的卡厄斯，为不构成职权上的僭越以及给异象管理局的工作添麻烦，典狱长将他托付给了管理局，转入了专攻涉异犯罪的E.T.D小队。
Content.LocalizedString:
Before working for the Bureau of Anomaly Control, Chaos was once the graveyard keeper for Ghroth Island. He was responsible for overseeing criminals, not knowing that he would be catching criminals in the future.

Eventually, a major incident—the jailbreaking of a dangerous Esper criminal—would push him to join the Bureau. Though it was not his fault, Chaos blamed himself for not monitoring the inmates more effectively. To make up for his mistake, he swore that he'd put in Ghroth Islalnd every criminal who deserves to be there. Only after that, would he return to meet the warden.
Since no one could hold back Chaos once he made up his mind, the warden, who didn't want to overstep and cause trouble to the BAC, entrusted him to the Bureau and transferred him to ETD to deal with anomaly crimes.

Content.SourceString:
在进入格赫罗斯岛之前，卡厄斯是一座小岛上的异象猎人。那时他的名字还叫「康拉克」，这是他的本名。这个由父母给予的名字最终被他舍弃，随着往日一同沉到海底。

康拉克曾因为一场海难，和另外11名同伴流落到一片与世隔绝的海域。
这片海域中有一片群岛，相对未开化，甚至没有互联网。康拉克和同伴们在其中一座小岛暂时定居，却一直想返回故乡。没有岛民愿意离开自己的故土送他们去往未知的远方，也没有外界的船只路过此处。同伴们商议，不如共造一艘船，自己驶回故乡。此船被命名为「巨石号」。
巨石号完工后，还需要筹备航行物资。因此在下水的前两年，巨石号主要在岛屿间从事货运航行以赚取经费。身为异能者，大家也经常接取异象委托，为居民们处理了很多棘手的麻烦。渐渐地，「巨石号猎人」在这里成为了家喻户晓的英雄。
最后，物资终于筹备妥当，却已有人不愿离开此地返乡。面对海岛稳定的生活和「英雄」的美名，他们不愿意踏上另一程未知的旅途。最后登船的只有5人。

航行中途，巨石号遭遇风暴，康拉克坠海，同伴搜寻无果放弃。
当时，「格赫罗斯」正处于这片海域，坠海的康拉克被一位押解者救下，后被收留。
加入格赫罗斯岛后，康拉克将自己的名字更为「卡厄斯」。
Content.LocalizedString:
Before entering Ghroth Island, Chaos was an Anomaly Hunter on a small island, where he went by his old name, Conrak. Eventually, he would abandon the name he received from his parents like a sunken boat in the sea.

Conrak once got into a shipwreck with another 11 crewmates. They found themselves in an ocean isolated from the world.
There was an archipelago in the ocean, which didn't even have internet access. Conrak and his crewmates settled on one of the islands but never stopped wanting to go back. Unfortunately, no islander was willing to leave their home to ferry them across unknown waters, and no outside vessels passed through the islands. The group decided to build a ship and sail home by themselves. They named the ship "the Boulder."
Once they built the Boulder, the group began to save up supplies for their return trip. For two years, the group navigated the Boulder around the islands to transport goods for funds. Since the group members were also Anomaly Hunters, they often took commissions, solving many issues that plagued the islanders. Gradually the "Boulder Hunters" became known local heroes.
In the end, because the group lived peacefully on the islands and was praised as heroes, some of them no longer wished to risk another adventure to return. Only five of them decided to go back.

However, on its return journey, the Boulder went through a storm. Conrak fell into the sea, and his companions weren't able to find him.
Luckily, Conrak fell into the sea near Ghroth Island and was saved by an Undertaker from the Island.
Once he formally joined Ghroth Island, Conrak changed his name to Chaos.

Content.SourceString:
远在巨石号的故事开始之前，康拉克只是某座海边小城中的普通少年。那时风平浪静，他常在海边眺望，此后半生的波涛汹涌还是他目所不能及。

13岁时，父母将康拉克送上远航的船只，并告诉他这是为将来成为海员做准备。
康拉克不知道他的父母并不爱他，不知道自己是这个穷苦家庭的累赘。他那时还觉得自己将来会成为一名海员，挣很多很多钱，带着爸爸妈妈去很远的地方幸福生活。他还带回过一条狗，靠节省自己的零花钱喂养它，希望将来自己不在家时，小狗能代替自己照顾爸爸妈妈。
康拉克拆开最后一袋狗粮，亲吻小狗的面颊。他朝着家人挥挥手登上船，他不知道这艘船永远不会返航。
事实上，康拉克被带上了一艘去往荒岛的黑船。这艘黑船最终没有靠岸。
航行中途，船只遭遇风暴沉没。康拉克觉醒异能，黑烟化作一条新船。他与船上另外的同伴凭借异能奇迹般生还——流落到一片与世隔绝的海域。
17岁的康拉克和同伴们的故事，从此开始。
Content.LocalizedString:
Long before the Boulder went on its adventures, Conrak was an ordinary boy living in a small seaside town. The sea was calm, and he would often stand at the shore gazing at the water, with no way of seeing the storms that would occupy the second half of his life.

When Conrak was 13, his parents put him on a boat to travel far. They said they were preparing Conrak for the life of a sailor.
Conrak didn't know that his parents didn't love him, nor did he know that he was seen as a burden to their struggling family. He merely believed that he would become a sailor, make a great deal of money, then take his parents somewhere far away for a happier life. He even brought home a dog, feeding it out of his own pocket money, hoping that when he was away, the dog would look after his parents.
Conrak opened the last bag of dog food and kissed the dog on the cheek, then waved at his family and boarded the ship, not knowing it would never return.
In fact, the ship was a smuggler's ship, and its destination was an uninhabited island, though it never got there.
Midway through the voyage, the ship sank in a storm. Conrak awakened his Esper Ability, and black smoke took shape in the form of a ship. He and the other survivors miraculously made it through, carried by their abilities—only to find themselves in an ocean isolated from the rest of the world.
From here unfolds the story of the 17-year-old Conrak and his companions.

Content.SourceString:
「你终将背负着恶名死去。」
卡厄斯曾收到过这样的预言。那时巨石号尚未完工，一位神秘的老者拦下步履匆匆的他，留下这句话便离去。
这句话在卡厄斯心里徘徊至今。他有时觉得这种没来由的模糊言辞不值得深究，却又总在任务出纰漏时无可避免地想到，那座岛上既往的预言悉数实现，从未有错。他就在这样的纠结中惩处了不计其数的恶徒。
不过，这并不意味着他是为了反抗预言才追求正义。他从小就热衷于惩恶扬善，而预言让他产生一种隐秘的逆反心，于是他对此更为执着，成了现在这幅嫉恶如仇的模样。
Content.LocalizedString:
"You will die with infamy."
Chaos found himself on the receiving end of such foretelling. When they were still building the Boulder, a mysterious old person stopped him suddenly and left him with these words.
Somehow, Chaos never forgot them. At times, he would tell himself that unfounded words aren't worth dwelling on, but whenever a mission goes wrong, the words would come back to haunt him. Every omen from that island has come true. Even in doubt of his own fate, he brought countless wrongdoers to justice.
That doesn't mean he pursues justice to defy the omens. He's had a passion for fighting evil and upholding good since he was young. The fortelling simply stirred a hidden, rebellious streak in him, making him more driven, until he became the relentless force against evil he is today.

Content.SourceString:
巨石号上有一位名叫「伊卡莉娅」的异能者，矮个子，长着一对翅膀。黑船沉船时，伊卡莉娅因为能够飞行逃过一劫。平日里她也很喜欢借着翅膀飞来飞去，经常调侃自己是因为没有脚踏实地才不会长个子。康拉克管她叫「小不点」。
她没有父母，从小和哥哥一起长大。哥哥总爱说自己如何辛苦抚养她，其实对她的生死毫不关心。因此虽然她完全有能力自己飞回家乡，却还是跟着大家留在岛上。
伊卡莉娅死于巨石号与异象「克拉肯」的战斗。她的异能翅膀并非真正的羽翼，而是由一种易融材质构成。在战斗中，她为了吸引异象的火力不慎飞得太高，太阳融化了她的翅膀，因此坠落，被杀。

那段时间里，康拉克苦于自己的异能没有更多用处，正在努力思考这团烟雾究竟还能捏成什么样子。开战前他眼前忽然闯过一只飞鸟。于是他想，倘若真能造出一只飞鸟，他就可以飞到空中去了。
这个念头出现在一个最不合宜的时间：既不能在眼下的战斗中发挥用处，又足以带来无穷的懊悔。假如早一点想到，飞鸟就能把伊卡莉娅接住了。
其实早一点也仍旧来不及。

时至今日，卡厄斯还在尝试用烟雾造出真正的飞鸟。他已经练习许多年，仍旧只能做出几只小鸟，短暂地飞出几米，连地上的灰尘也没法带起。
Content.LocalizedString:
There was an Esper who went by the name of Icaria on the Boulder. She was short and had a pair of wings, which saved her when the smuggler's ship sank. She usually enjoys zipping around, often joking that she never grew taller because her feet never touched the ground. Conrak called her "Shorty."
Icaria didn't have any parents. She just had an older brother, who liked to make a big deal about working hard to raise her. The brother, however, never cared about her. That's why Icaria decided to stay on the island, though she was capable of flying home herself.
Icaria died when the crew fought an anomaly known as the Kraken. Her wings were not made from feathers, but from some material that melted in high heat. During the fight, she tried to make the anomaly focus on her, but her wings melted when she flew too high and fell right into the Kraken.

After that, Conrak was frustrated about the limitations of his abilities. He tried to experiment with what kind of shapes his smoke could form. Just before a battle, a bird flew past him. He thought that if he could shape his smoke into a bird, he could take to the sky.
This idea didn't come at a good time: he couldn't apply it to the battle at hand, but it was enough to make him regretful… If only he had thought of it sooner, he could have saved Icaria.
Nonetheless, the idea wouldn't have helped even if he had it earlier. 

Chaos is still trying to create flying birds with his smoke. Even after years of practice, he is still only able to create a few small birds that could fly a few meters, unable to even carry the tiniest speck of dust.

Content.SourceString:
「时间行进到第六百年。暴雨连绵四十个昼夜，洪水滔天，把世上的崎岖都填作平原。」
……
……
他说他名叫「平原」，听着就不是个正经名字。他是个捉摸不透的家伙，好像什么都懂，但是从来没见过他战斗。他老是说「我是全知全能的哦」，虽然他说的东西确实从不出错……但还是看他不爽。
我们的船已经造起来了，平原说得取个名字，就叫「巨石号」吧。石头扔进海里，不就沉下去了么？这名字真不吉利。但其他人好像都很喜欢，尤其是那个养藤蔓的疯女人。疯女人还说要给巨石号写故事，什么英雄啊史诗啊，听着就头大。平原听完居然还笑着说「我们会成为英雄的」，有这么自信吗？
……
委托越来越多了，我们的名声也越来越大。大家都说我们是英雄。
平原说出来的话还是从不出错，我真佩服他。对了，船已经下水，现在可以喊他「船长」了。我也不太想喊他那个奇怪的名字。不过话说回来，这种什么都懂的人应该想去哪就去哪吧，为什么当初会被送上那条黑船？
……
最近海里出现了一只章鱼似的大怪物，伤害了很多人，我们有义务打倒它。船长居然犹豫了很久才决定要去讨伐。我不知道他又有什么考量，只知道这是我们必须要做的事。
制定作战计划的时候，船长一直在提醒小不点「绝对不要向高处飞」。她也飞不了太高吧？
……
结束了。我们赢了，但是小不点死了。疯女人竟然喝多了没来。这场战斗那么重要，她竟然没来……她要是来了，小不点可能就不会死！但现在说什么也没用……
……
物资什么的都准备好了，我们可以离开这儿了。但有的人不想走，他们宁可留在这儿继续当「英雄」……他们的想法也说得通，谁知道回去的路上又会遇到什么危险……但我得回去。
我得回去。
……
……
我明白了。当初，爸妈应该知道那是条黑船的。
不必回去了……格赫罗斯也是个挺不错的地方。
Content.LocalizedString:
"In the 600th year, rain fell for forty days and forty nights. Waters rose upon the face of the earth, swallowing every hill and filling every valley until all was made plain."
…
…
He said his name was "Plain," but that didn't sound like a real name. He's a mysterious guy. It's like he knows everything, but I've never seen him in a fight. He likes to claim that he's omniscient and omnipotent, and although he's never been wrong… I just can't help but find him annoying.
Our boat is built. Plain said we needed to give it a name and proposed to call it "the Boulder." Hello??? Wouldn't a boulder sink in the sea? What an unlucky name! The others, however, seemed to like the name, especially that crazy woman with the vines, who said she'll write a heroic epic from the adventures of the Boulder. Is she serious? Plain even gave her his approval, saying that we'll all become heroes. Where did thIs confidence come from?
…
We're actually getting more and more commissions and we're getting more famous. Everyone thinks we're heroes.
Plain has yet to be wrong. I do respect that. By the way, the boat is operational, and we can now call him "Captain." I don't like to call him "Plain," so that's a win for me. Anyway, if he truly knew about everything, why would he ever be sent on that smuggler's ship in the first place?
…
There've been sightings of a monster that resembles an octopus. Many people got hurt. We need to take it down. The captain hesitated for a long time before deciding to accept the commission. I'm not sure what's on his mind. I just know that it has to be us.
During our strategic meeting, the captain kept telling Shorty to not fly too high. It's not like she can fly that high, right?
…
It's over. We won. Shorty died. I can't believe the crazy woman with vines drank too much and didn't show up. This was such an important fight… Had she been there, Shorty might have survived. But thoughts like this won't help…
…
We have enough supplies to go back, but some don't want to leave. They want to be "heroes" here… I get it. We don't know what kind of dangers lies ahead on our way back… but still, I need to return.
I must return.
…
…
Now I realize, my parents knew it was a smuggler's ship.
I don't have to go back now… Ghroth Island is not that bad anyway.

Content.SourceString: 你好，我是E.T.D六队的卡厄斯。很高兴认识你，希望我们合作愉快……喂喂，我只是按部就班说点场面话而已，没那么好笑吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Greetings. This is Chaos from ETD-6. Pleasure to meet you. I'm looking forward to… Hey, I'm just trying to be formal, stop laughing!

Content.SourceString: 为什么要戴面罩？呃，我对外的解释是「提高作战效率」。真正的理由？你确定要听吗？好吧……因为这样很帅。这么看着我干嘛！真的很帅啊！你不觉得吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Why am I wearing a mask? I tell people I want to be more efficient in combat. But the real reason… are you sure you want to know? Well, I think it looks cool. Okay, stop staring at me like that. I really think it's cool…

Content.SourceString: 任务很麻烦？别害怕，只要一点一点地缕清头绪，事情就一定能办成。就是因为这种信念，我做成了很多看似不可能的事。唯独……算了，不提。
Content.LocalizedString: Is the mission a lot of trouble? No need to be concerned. As long as you sort things out one at a time, you'll be able to succeed. This belief helped me do many things that seemed impossible at first, except for… well, never mind.

Content.SourceString: 我没有养狗啊。如果你指的是「猎犬」，那是我的异能。不过，养条真正的狗好像也不错呢……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't have a pet dog, but if you mean a "hound," then that's my Esper Ability. Hmm, maybe having a real dog as a pet would be nice…

Content.SourceString: 我的心情，和阳光一样明媚！
Content.LocalizedString: My mood is as sunny as the sunshine!

Content.SourceString: 带伞了吗？要不要把外套借你？
Content.LocalizedString: Got an umbrella? Do you need my coat?

Content.SourceString: 早上好！新的一天开始咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning! A brand new day begins!

Content.SourceString: 该做决定了——午饭到底吃什么！
Content.LocalizedString: It's time for a decision. What should I get for lunch?

Content.SourceString: 晚安，早睡早起能长高哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Good night. Sleep early, grow taller.

Content.SourceString: 「泯除方块」太好玩了！看着一屏幕方块噼噼啪啪消失，心情就会变好啊~
Content.LocalizedString: Tetrominoes is so fun! I love it when the lines all vanish!

Content.SourceString: 现在的手机设计得也太复杂了吧！要我说，手机只要能打电话、发短信……哦对，再加一个「泯除方块」，有这三个功能就够了！
Content.LocalizedString: Phones these days are too complicated. I just need a phone that can call, text, and… oh, play Tetrominoes!

Content.SourceString: 身体的自愈能力是有限的，一旦超出限度，就没法恢复原样了。真遗憾啊。
Content.LocalizedString: The body's self-healing powers are limited. It won't heal when it suffers too much damage. Such a shame.

Content.SourceString: 我可以用异能造出刀剑之类结构简单的武器，但枪械就很难了。也不是完全没可能，只要我能记住每个部件的结构……不行，完全没可能。
Content.LocalizedString: I can use my abilities to create weapons with simple structures like swords and blades, but guns are tricky. It's not like I can't, but I'll have to remember all the components… Fine, I can't.

Content.SourceString: 我在一个远离都市的地方待过几年，在那儿，人们依靠「神的旨意」生活。神的旨意总是对的，因为人们总能想出办法把它解读成对的。预言也差不多，假如你找到了一个「好」的解读，那就相信它吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I spent a few years in a place far from the city, where people lived by the "will of God." The will of God was always right, because people could always find a way to interpret it as right. Prophecies are much the same. If you find a good interpretation, then believe in it.

Content.SourceString: 我的异能呢，就是把一团不知道哪儿来的烟雾捏成各种样子。跟那些呼风唤雨的异能比起来弱得离谱，是吧？但因为这个，我学会了靠「自己」做成更多事。也是件好事啊~
Content.LocalizedString: My ability? It's shaping a mass of smoke from who knows where into all kinds of forms. Pretty pathetic compared to those that can change the course of nature, right? But because of that, I learned to rely on myself to get things done. That's not so bad!

Content.SourceString: 在一座遥远的海边小城里，一个婴儿出生了。那时他还不知道，27年后自己会成为一个27岁的青年……怎么啦，这话也挑不出毛病吧？
Content.LocalizedString: In a small seaside town far away, a baby was born. He didn't know it then, but 27 years later, he'd grow into a 27-year-old fellow… What? I didn't say anything wrong, did I?

Content.SourceString: 不是我吹牛啊，我告别的次数恐怕比你说「早上好」的次数还多。在海上漂来漂去的时候我总会想，天地没有真正的边界，那些已经说过再见的人，兴许还能再见。
Content.LocalizedString: Not to brag, but I've probably said my goodbyes more times than you've said good morning. Drifting out at sea, I'd always think the world has no real limits, so maybe the people I said goodbye to… I'll meet again.

Content.SourceString: 队长只是看起来阴沉而已，其实是个很不错的家伙。我刚来的时候不太会用智能手机，全靠他一步步教我。要是没他检查，我拿到手机的第二天就要被自己设置的100个闹钟吵醒，想想就后怕啊！
Content.LocalizedString: The Captain only appears to be gloomy. He's actually a really good guy. When I first arrived, I didn't know how to use a smartphone. He walked me through it step by step. If he hadn't checked for me, I'd have woken up to 100 alarms on the next day. Just thinking about it gives me the chills!

Content.SourceString: 他……总感觉他应该是我的熟人啊，可我就是说不出他到底是谁。我有问过他，是不是在几年前跟我一起出过海，结果他就回我一句：「有没有过呢？」，搞得云里雾里的，连这种事都能记不清吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I've always had the feeling that he… was somebody that I used to know. I just couldn't figure out who he was. I asked him once whether he'd ever gone out to sea with me a few years ago. All he said was: "Have I?" I was dumbfounded. How can anyone forget that?

Content.SourceString: 我搞不懂灵可的脑袋里到底在想什么。但这不重要，在找人和异象的时候，相信她的直觉准没错。稍微有点麻烦的是，她总是一不留神就跑到奇怪的地方去，像我以前另一个小不点朋友。不过，我那朋友可比她笨多了……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't know what's going on in Linko's brain. Well, that's not important. If you're looking for a person or an anomaly, you can simply trust her intuitions. The only problem is, she often finds herself in strange places. It's the same problem a little friend of mine had. Though frankly speaking, my friend is not as bright as Linko…

Content.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔对自己苛责太多，明明很多事不是她能左右的……我挺佩服她，成长在那种环境里，还能保持正直善良……那位掌柜的，想必对她影响很大吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Daffodill blames herself too much, even for things out of her own control… She's impressive. She grew up in a less-than-ideal environment, but managed to stay kindhearted. The owner of Eibon… must be a great influence for her.

Content.SourceString: 难以理解的怪人……和格赫罗斯岛的一些罪犯不相上下。不如说，她本就该属于那儿。
Content.LocalizedString: She's strange. Almost as strange as criminals on Ghroth Island. To be precise, she belongs there.

Content.SourceString: 格赫罗斯岛……我在那儿工作、锻炼，学会了把直觉变成技巧，也学会了分辨善恶。我很感谢他们的收留，除此之外，对那儿倒也没什么特别的感受。
Content.LocalizedString: At Ghroth Island… I worked, trained, honed my intuition into a technique, and learned how to tell good from evil. I appreciate them letting me stay there. Other than that, I don't have much personal feelings.

Content.SourceString: 我能感觉到，六队并不像一个真正的团队那样团结一心，每个人都有自己的心事。唉，这也没法强求，只要不影响执行任务就行了。
Content.LocalizedString: I can feel that ETD-6 isn't that unified of a team. Everyone has their own issues. Well, this isn't something I can ask of them. I just need them to do their jobs.
Aha! My body is feeling stronger!

Content.SourceString: 精神焕发！不过，感觉还有提升空间啊~
Content.LocalizedString: My spirits are high! Well, I can do even better.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，终于可以使出全力了！
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, I can finally give it my all!

Content.SourceString: 哇，这个给我，你确定？太好了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Woah, this is for me? Are you sure? You're too kind!

Content.SourceString: 哦哦，我一直想要这个！多谢你了！
Content.LocalizedString: Oooh! I've always wanted this. Thanks a bunch!
I'll… take care of the damage done.

Content.SourceString: 乖乖在这儿待着，别乱跑。
这是什么？看着还挺少见的？

Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… this is harder than I expected.
Is this the end of the journey…?
I can't get hit for nothing…

Content.SourceString: 我的对手，下场一般都不太好。
Content.LocalizedString: My opponents usually don't end up well.
Captain, when did you come here?
Hey, don't leave me this mess!
Little one, you can rely on others a little!
Hey hey, aim before you move!
